§6Fullerene§f

§aMagenta carbon powder processed through a laser  -  the precursor to crystalline fullerite!§f

Fullerene is a vibrant magenta allotrope of carbon made in the §bSILEX§f. You feed it §bFullerene Solution§f with a §bBiSmUTh Laser Crystal§f at 1.0x or higher focus. One crystal per operation.

§6Fullerene Solution§f comes from the Industrial Mixer: §e500mB§f HPS + Fine Soot yields §e250mB§f solution.

§6What it is for§f:
§b•§f Crystalline Fullerite (Ore Acidizer): §e4×§f Fullerene + §e1,000mB§f BTX yields §e1×§f Crystalline Fullerite. This is the main use.
§b•§f Works as a magenta dye in vanilla and modded recipes.

§6Production chain§f: HPS to Fullerene Solution (Industrial Mixer) to Fullerene (SILEX) to Crystalline Fullerite (Ore Acidizer with BTX).

§ePS:§f Both HPS and BTX are required. The Pyrolysis Oven and everything beyond it depends on this chain. Do not skip it!
